What time is it?

tip: Stating 30 minutes past the hour (halfway to the next hour).
translation_en: It is half past one (1:30).
It is a quarter to three (2:45).

sentence: Es ist fünf nach halb vier.
translation_en: It is five past half past three (3:35).

sentence: Es ist zehn vor halb fünf.
translation_en: It is ten to half past four (4:20).
It is five to twelve (11:55).
The course begins at 9:00 AM.

sentence: Wir haben von 12 bis 13 Uhr Pause.
translation_en: We have a break from 12 to 1 PM.

sentence: Ich stehe um sieben Uhr auf.
translation_en: I get up at seven o'clock.
In the morning I work.

sentence: Am Mittag esse ich mit Kollegen.
translation_en: At noon I eat with colleagues.
In the afternoon I go shopping.
In the evening I watch TV.
In the night I sleep.
When does the movie start?

sentence: Der Film fängt um 20 Uhr an.
translation_en: The movie starts at 8 PM.

sentence: Rufst du mich heute Abend an?
translation_en: Will you call me tonight?

sentence: Ja, ich rufe dich um acht an.
translation_en: Yes, I'll call you at eight.
Do you have time on Friday?

sentence: Nein, am Freitag habe ich keine Zeit.
tip: Declining due to lack of time.
translation_en: No, on Friday I have no time.
On Friday I have to work.

sentence: Und wie geht es am Samstag?
translation_en: And how about Saturday?
On Saturday I have time.
Are we going to the cinema?

sentence: Ja, das ist eine super Idee!
translation_en: Yes, that is a super idea!

tip: Asking if someone feels like doing something.
translation_en: Do you feel like going to the cinema?
Yes, I feel like it.

sentence: Nein, ich habe heute keine Lust.
translation_en: No, I don't feel like it today.
When are we meeting?

sentence: Treffen wir uns um Viertel vor acht?
translation_en: Shall we meet at a quarter to eight?
Yes, that fits well.
No, that is too late.
Does seven work too?
Shall we go drink a coffee?

sentence: Die Bibliothek ist von 9 bis 18 Uhr geöffnet.
translation_en: The library is open from 9 to 6.

sentence: Das Geschäft ist am Sonntag geschlossen.
translation_en: The store is closed on Sunday.

sentence: Wann machst du das Geschäft auf?
translation_en: When do you open the store?

sentence: Ich mache um neun Uhr auf.
translation_en: I open at nine o'clock.

sentence: Wir machen das Restaurant um 23 Uhr zu.
translation_en: We close the restaurant at 11 PM.

sentence: Ich räume heute die Wohnung auf.
translation_en: I am cleaning up the apartment today.

tip: Asking someone to walk with you.
translation_en: Are you going for a walk with me?
On the weekend I sleep in (long).

sentence: Er isst am Nachmittag einen Kuchen.
translation_en: He eats a cake in the afternoon.
Are you coming along to the swimming pool?

tip: Warning that an event is starting.
translation_en: The soccer game is starting right away.
What are your plans for today?

tip: Answering that you have no special plans.
translation_en: Nothing special.

sentence: Gehen wir heute Abend in die Kneipe?
translation_en: Are we going to the pub tonight?

sentence: Tut mir leid, ich bin schon verabredet.
translation_en: I'm sorry, I already have plans/an appointment.
A pity, maybe tomorrow?
No problem. I have time!
The sign says: Closed today.

sentence: Es ist schon spät, ich gehe ins Bett.
tip: Stating an intention because of the time.
translation_en: It is already late, I am going to bed.

sentence: Wir treffen uns um Punkt acht.
translation_en: We are meeting at exactly eight o'clock.

sentence: Machst du bitte das Fenster auf?
tip: Asking someone to open a window.
translation_en: Will you please open the window?
